The Magpies' previous away game a month ago also saw them defeated 4-1 on the Monday Night Football at Leeds. A second loss in three games comes after Jaissle had enjoyed an unbeaten five-game start across all competitions, but recent results have seen his side fall to 11th in the Premier League table. Norris and Piastri made contact on the last lap of Saturday's shortened race when battling for fourth, which the stewards did not penalise either driver for. However, McLaren team principal Andrea Stella labelled the incident as "not acceptable" while Norris was not keen to talk about the collision on Saturday and told Sky Sports F1 : "As a team we all spoke about it. messages.text: Lewis left out of England’s World Cup opener

metadata.summary: Mikey Lewis has been left out of England’s squad for their Rugby League World Cup opener against Tonga, while Jack Welsby has been named on the bench by head coach Brian McDermott.
metadata.content: Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis has been left out of England's opening match against Tonga | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis has been left out of England's opening match against Tonga England face Tonga at HBF Park in Perth on Saturday (10.05am), before taking on France in the same city on October 24 and then Papua New Guinea in Wollongong on October 30 Tuesday 13 October 2026 09:40, UK Image: Mikey Lewis is one of three half-back options in the England World Cup squad Mikey Lewis has been left out of England’s squad for their Rugby League World Cup opener against Tonga, while Jack Welsby has been named on the bench by head coach Brian McDermott. Hull KR's Lewis, who edged 2025 Super League Man of Steel Jake Connor for a place in England's squad, has been named among the three reserves alongside Ben Currie and Ben Talty, leaving him set to miss out on selection. Jack Welsby had been widely tipped to start at full-back, but McDermott has instead opted for Gold Coast Titans star AJ Brimson. metadata.summary: Josh Allen racked up 331 total yards and two touchdowns, while Tyler Bass drilled a 45-yard field goal with 1:55 remaining in overtime after Greg Rousseau blocked a field goal attempt, lifting the Buffalo Bills to a thrilling 37-34 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Monday night.
metadata.content: Josh Allen clinches first overtime win of NFL career as Buffalo Bills beat Los Angeles Rams in thriller | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Josh Allen clinches first overtime win of NFL career as Buffalo Bills beat Los Angeles Rams in thriller Josh Allen rushes for 121 yards, passes for 210 yards and accounts for two touchdowns as the Buffalo Bills beat the Los Angeles Rams in overtime; watch the Jacksonville Jaguars face the Houston Texans in the final NFL London game of the season at Wembley, live on Sky Sports from 2pm Sunday Tuesday 13 October 2026 07:21, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Rams from Week 5 of the NFL season. Josh Allen racked up 331 total yards and two touchdowns, while Tyler Bass drilled a 45-yard field goal with 1:55 remaining in overtime after Greg Rousseau blocked a field goal attempt, lifting the Buffalo Bills to a thrilling 37-34 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Monday night. Allen passed for 210 yards and rushed for 121 more for the Bills (4-1), who rallied to win a frantic game befitting the teams with the NFL's last two MVPs at quarterback. The Bills appeared to be in trouble after James Cook fumbled early in OT, but Allen got another chance - and he finally won an overtime game for the first time in his career while besting Matthew Stafford, who passed for 383 yards and three touchdowns.
